purpose: Modify a noun through a conversational resemblance.
keywords: Noun / plain phrase + みたいな + noun.
It is a white flower like snow.
I want to become someone like my teacher.
formation: Noun / plain phrase + みたいな + noun.
restrictions: The following noun is what is being described.
mistake: Use な before the modified noun, not に.
